The story takes place in Päivänvalo Forest, in the Kingdom of Fidavar.
Lundström Grove is located northwest of the forest. The fauns have adapted their homes to trees, some even living under the roots of ancient oaks.
Fauns prefer not to mingle with humans or other races in general; they prefer to remain isolated.
The Päivänvalo Forest is slowly becoming polluted and dying, as the curse of the Arno Lands spreads.
The Cursed Lands of Arno are north of the Forest. They are dead forests and stinking swamps, a barren land where nothing grows or sprouts. These lands were the ancient Kingdom of Vieno, neighboring Fidavar, and home to the Lich King, a powerful necromancer who cast the curse when he was defeated 700 years ago. The curse had never budged, but recently, for some reason, it has begun to advance.
Fauns are magical creatures, attuned to the forests. Both male and female fauns can become pregnant and bear children.
All fauns worship the god Silvanus, god of the forest and wild nature.
